remarks: Nestled on a serene cul-de-sac in the sought-after Westover neighborhood, this spacious and light-filled contemporary home is perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. The oversized living room features soaring cathedral ceilings, a striking fireplace, and flows seamlessly into the open-plan dining area, which opens onto a generous deck overlooking the beautifully landscaped yard-ideal for gatherings year-round. The updated kitchen, complete with modern appliances, adjoins a versatile office/playroom, offering flexibility for work or play. The home boasts hardwood floors and tastefully remodeled bathrooms. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet, a private balcony, and a luxurious bathroom. The lower-level walk-out is designed for comfort and versatility, featuring a family room with a stunning stone fireplace, a wet bar, full bath, full in-law suite & two additional bedrooms. Located just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, this home combines tranquility with convenience, making it an exceptional opportunity in Westover.
